# `factory/preview.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Manages preview sessions — temporary environments held open so humans can manually review running applications during the review stage. Previews run on a sealed network with port forwarding from the host, and are tracked by feature and held in memory by this server process.
